decisions.reason: This service sits directly in the firm's core messaging competence, was prominent on the home page, and with the firm's own R&D and a growing market it is more likely to be improved and retained than withdrawn.

Document capture and recognition extends the firm's document workflow offer and even showed a concrete customer reference, so the firm's strong related knowledge and absorptive capacity make continued commercialization likely.

Email and fax conversion is closely tied to the firm's established multichannel communication business, but as a less prominently presented niche service it has a somewhat higher risk of withdrawal than the more central offers.

Fax delivery optimization is very close to the firm's installed base and can be supported with existing knowledge, yet its narrower feature character and the longer-term shift away from fax raise the chance of discontinuation somewhat.

Email sandbox threat protection fits well with the firm's secure business messaging positioning, and given its internal R&D and security-related capabilities the firm is likely to keep developing rather than dropping it.
